description: Records match the data contract schema and types (Pandera)
Course codes match '<PREFIX> <NNN>[-<ROMAN>]' or 'REQ-*'
Credits are integers in 1..16 (0 only where rules.json states 0; ug_background excluded)
level is first digit of the course number * 100, null only for REQ-* placeholders
Required fields are not null or empty
No course code appears twice (raw: within one source document)
requirement: spec: no course code appears twice

description: No exact duplicate records (all content fields equal, provenance ignored)
Course titles agree with the timetable title for the same code (catches typos like 'Algrithms')
requirement: general: spelling / title consistency against timetable

description: Titles have no leading/trailing whitespace, double spaces or trailing punctuation
No two different codes have near-duplicate titles (rapidfuzz token_sort_ratio >= 92)
requirement: general: near-duplicate titles (warning, needs human review)
examples: [{"codes": ["ES 417", "ES 668"], "titles": ["5G and Beyond", "5G and Beyond"], "ratio": 100.0}, {"codes": ["ES 654", "ES 678"], "titles": ["Machine Learning", "Machine Learning"], "ratio": 100.0}]
note: warning only: cross-listed UG/PG or special-topics versions can share a title

description: Every prerequisite code exists in courses.json
The prerequisite graph has no cycles (and no self loops)
Credit totals agree with the handbook: every total is 82, per-track minimums fit in it, splits sum to it
requirement: spec: credit totals match the handbook
